title: Camp Billings

services.name: Evening Programs
services.desc: Each night after dinner, we have an Evening Program designed to let 170 campers share one all-camp experience. These programs include old classics like: Capture the flag, Campfires, Casino nights, Dances & Square Dances, Biffers & Medics, Jack’s Alive, Grab Bag, Battle of the Bands. We are also keeping things interesting with a series of newer programs, most of which were made up right here at camp: Operation Rock Drop, Divide and Conquer, and Billings University. blurb: Camp Billings is a summer camp for kids ages 8-15 on beautiful Lake Fairlee in Vermont. For more than a century, Billings has inspired our campers to build independence and enjoy the freedom to try new activities every day.
